_what: The six tool-driven catches shown in fig_critic_cases and tab:cases. Every string here is copied from the run's own per-clip row; nothing is paraphrased upward.

_provenance.note: This run is an earlier physics-routing pass, not the run behind tab:results. It is cited here only for the per-case measurement traces, never for a recall figure.
_provenance.screening: Every candidate was re-derived from the three raw sources above rather than from the gallery's per-clip badge: the badge is a per-clip count and the trace block is assembled per clip, so a card can look tool-driven when the specialist abstained or when the matcher credited a different flaw. Ten candidates were discarded that way. All six survivors were then eye-checked against every decoded frame of their clip.

cases.subject: dolphin
cases.claim: A dolphin leaps out of the water
cases.human: The dolphin … merely swims to the surface and then dives back down without jumping out of the water.
cases.measured: hops: required yes, measured no — largest vertical excursion 0.00 of the dolphin's own radius over 37 tracked frames; 0 excursions reach the 0.30-radius threshold

cases.subject: water bottle
cases.claim: The water bottle is rolling on a car floor.
cases.human: The water bottle … remains in its original position and never rolls on the floor.
cases.measured: rolling: required yes, measured no — surface moves 10.20 px/frame against 11.00 px/frame of background flow, over 256 frame pairs

cases.subject: sun
cases.human: The sun remains completely stationary in its original position without slowly rising.
cases.measured: vertical travel: required up — largest departure from its starting height 0.71 radius, under the 0.75 that counts as travel; net −2 px over 192 tracked frames

cases.subject: babies
cases.human: There are only five babies in the video, which does not match the quantity requested in the text prompt.

cases.subject: F-22 jets
cases.claim: Three F-22 Raptor fighter jets are in tight formation.
cases.human: A total of four fighter jets appear in the video, which does not match the requested quantity of three.

cases.subject: graduation banner
cases.claim: A massive 'CONGRATULATIONS GRADUATES' banner is being unfurled across a university building.
